description: This is a test class for the EducationService component within the OrangeHRM Admin Service plugin. It includes unit tests for methods such as getEducationList, deleteEducations, getEducationById, and getEducationByName, verifying their interactions with the EducationDao mock and the expected behavior.

classes.name: EducationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the EducationService, testing CRUD operations and data retrieval methods using mock objects.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the education list using a mocked EducationDao, verifying the returned list count and item type.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests deletion of education entries by IDs, verifying the number of records deleted.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an Education entity by its name.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EducationService and loading test fixture data.
